decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 29 November 2006, the erection of single storey rear extension to the basement level, which is 5.3m wide, by 3.0m long, and 2.9m high, as shown on drawing numbers; AD 063 PR PD APPLICATION rev 1: 1. Basement, Ground Floor, First Floor, Attic, Front Elevation, Rear Elevation, Side Elevation 1 and Side Elevation 2, all received 30 November 2006,, was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

Following the erection of the rear extension, the resulting building would fall outside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, as the total volume of the existing and proposed extensions to the dwellinghouse would exceed 50m3 of its original volume. It is noted that the original house has previous extensions to both the ground floor and first floors.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a rear extension at basement level.
